title: Cover control expiry on lifecycle and read operations and retain generic lifecycle BEGIN-busy errors
outcome: Cover control expiry on lifecycle and read operations and retain generic lifecycle BEGIN-busy errors
acceptance: Add deterministic control-frame expiry cases for named_root_bind, session_status and at least one read operation, asserting typed refusal before dispatch and unchanged store state.
Add a lifecycle BEGIN-busy regression showing it retains generic storage_error rather than control_store_busy; keep the existing turn-operation certification behavior and all assertions.

completion.summary: Test-only coverage for control-request expiry on lifecycle and read operations, and for the generic lifecycle BEGIN-busy error. expired_lifecycle_and_read_frames_are_refused_before_dispatch shows that expired named_root_bind (a generation-0 frame that fails validation before any transaction), session_status (refused before its transaction opens) and turn_grant_read frames get control_request_expired and leave the store unchanged, while the same frames in time reach each operation's own answer. lifecycle_begin_busy_keeps_the_generic_storage_error shows that a busy BEGIN on the lifecycle named_root_bind keeps storage_error with the "database is locked" text and no no-change claim; turn operations and (since w-b64c) session_status keep control_store_busy. Full gate test-c5e6dd97 passed 12/12 on freeze 76778a9a. Two review rounds: round-1 Lows fixed; round-2 Codex clean and Claude's Low filed as w-32f5a7e983ec. Evaluations d85e154d and closure ae7f0de5 passed 2/2. Landed as 5b274201 and installed as build ddadeabe790e; all six live stores ready.
